title: Margherita
text:
Margherita (Pizza)
Pizza · Serves 1–3 depending on size
Classic hand-stretched pizza with slow-cooked tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella and basil, baked in a stone oven.
Ingredients: Mozzarella, Tomato sauce, Fresh basil, Olive oil
Sizes: Small (8 inch), Medium (10 inch), Large (12 inch)

title: Pepperoni
text:
Pepperoni (Pizza)
Pizza · Serves 1–3 depending on size
Rich marinara, melted mozzarella cheese, and crispy beef pepperoni slices with Italian herb seasoning.
Ingredients: Beef Pepperoni, Mozzarella, Marinara, Oregano
Sizes: Small (8 inch), Medium (10 inch), Large (12 inch)

title: Chicken Tikka
text:
Chicken Tikka (Pizza)
Pizza · Serves 1–3 depending on size
Spiced char-grilled chicken tikka chunks, red onions, bell peppers, mozzarella, and special herbs.
Ingredients: Tikka Chicken, Mozzarella, Onions, Bell Peppers
Sizes: Small (8 inch), Medium (10 inch), Large (12 inch)

title: Fajita
text:
Fajita (Pizza)
Pizza · Serves 1–3 depending on size
Mexican-style fajita chicken, sautéed bell peppers, sweet corn, melted mozzarella, and spicy jalapeños.
Ingredients: Fajita Chicken, Mozzarella, Jalapeños, Capsicum
Sizes: Small (8 inch), Medium (10 inch), Large (12 inch)

title: Veggie Supreme
text:
Veggie Supreme (Pizza)
Pizza · Serves 1–3 depending on size
Loaded with black olives, button mushrooms, bell peppers, sweet corn, onions, and premium mozzarella.
Ingredients: Mushrooms, Black Olives, Sweet Corn, Mozzarella
Sizes: Small (8 inch), Medium (10 inch), Large (12 inch)

title: Zinger Burger
text:
Zinger Burger (Burgers)
Burgers · Crispy & Juicy
Golden fried crispy chicken fillet topped with spicy mayo and shredded lettuce on a toasted sesame bun.
Ingredients: Crispy Fillet, Spicy Mayo, Iceberg Lettuce, Brioche Bun
Sizes: Single (Regular patty), Double (Double crispy patty), Combo (With fries & drink)

title: Beef Burger
text:
Beef Burger (Burgers)
Burgers · 100% Prime Beef
Flame-grilled seasoned beef patty with melted cheddar cheese, caramelized onions, pickles, and secret sauce.
Ingredients: Beef Patty, Cheddar Cheese, Pickles, Caramelized Onions
Sizes: Single (150g patty), Double (300g patties), Combo (With fries & drink)

title: Double Patty
text:
Double Patty (Burgers)
Burgers · Extra Large
Two smashed prime beef patties, double cheddar cheese slices, smokey BBQ mayo, and crisp lettuce.
Ingredients: Double Beef, Double Cheddar, BBQ Sauce, Sesame Bun
Sizes: Regular (Two patties), Monster (Triple patties), Combo (With fries & drink)

title: Fries
text:
Fries (Sides)
Sides · Crispy Golden
Freshly cut skin-on potatoes deep fried to golden crispiness and dusted with special salt seasoning.
Ingredients: Potato, Sea Salt, Vegetable Oil
Sizes: Regular (Single portion), Large (Sharing portion), Jumbo (Family bucket)

title: Loaded Fries
text:
Loaded Fries (Sides)
Sides · Cheesy & Saucy
Golden fries smothered in warm cheddar cheese sauce, crispy jalapeno bites, and chipotle garlic drizzle.
Ingredients: Fries, Cheddar Sauce, Jalapeños, Chipotle Mayo
Sizes: Regular (Single bowl), Large (Party platter)

title: Garlic Bread
text:
Garlic Bread (Sides)
Sides · Warm & Buttery
Crispy baguette slices toasted with roasted garlic herb butter and fresh Italian parsley.
Ingredients: French Baguette, Garlic Butter, Parsley, Oregano
Sizes: Plain (4 slices), Cheesy (4 slices with mozzarella)

title: Nuggets (6)
text:
Nuggets (6) (Sides)
Sides · Tender Bites
Bite-sized tender all-white chicken breast nuggets battered and fried golden brown with dipping sauce.
Ingredients: Chicken Breast, Crispy Breading, Dip Sauce
Sizes: 6 Pcs (Single box), 12 Pcs (Sharing box)

title: Coke 500ml
text:
Coke 500ml (Drinks)
Drinks · Chilled Refreshment
Classic Coca-Cola served ice cold.
Ingredients: Carbonated Water, Cola Syrup, Caramel Color
Sizes: 500ml (Bottle), 1.5L (Large bottle)

title: Mineral Water
text:
Mineral Water (Drinks)
Drinks · Pure Hydration
Pure natural mineral drinking water, chilled.
Ingredients: Natural Mineral Water
Sizes: Small (500ml), Large (1.5L)

title: Mint Margarita
text:
Mint Margarita (Drinks)
Drinks · Freshly Blended
Refreshing mocktail blended with fresh mint leaves, lemon juice, ice, and fizzy soda.
Ingredients: Fresh Mint, Lemon Juice, Soda, Black Salt
Sizes: Regular (350ml glass)

title: Lava Cake
text:
Lava Cake (Desserts)
Desserts · Warm & Decadent
Warm dark chocolate sponge cake with a rich molten Belgian chocolate center, dusted with icing sugar.
Ingredients: Dark Chocolate, Belgian Cocoa, Butter, Eggs
Sizes: Standard (Warm cake), With Ice Cream (With vanilla scoop)

title: Ice Cream
text:
Ice Cream (Desserts)
Desserts · Creamy Scoops
Artisanal creamy ice cream served chilled in your choice of flavors with chocolate drizzle.
Ingredients: Fresh Cream, Milk, Natural Flavors, Chocolate Sauce
Sizes: Single Scoop (1 scoop cup), Double Scoop (2 scoops cup), Sundae Bowl (With nuts & syrup)
